name: Input Group
summary: An input with a button or a text affix joined to it: search and submit, password reveal, copy to clipboard. The addon is a real sibling button, never an overlay sitting on top of the value.
demoNote: Zoom to 200% and watch the addon push the field narrower instead of covering the text. The password button changes its name rather than carrying aria-pressed, and the copy confirmation goes to a live region rather than rewriting the button.

contract.useWhen: A text input with a button joined to it, both reachable at 200% zoom.
keyboard: native: the button is a real sibling, so it is its own stop
failureModes: the button absolutely positioned over the input, so it swallows clicks meant for the text
no name on the addon — the same failure as icon-button, with a nicer border
the button overlapping the text at 200% zoom (SC 1.4.4)
a reveal toggle that renames itself mid-press, so AT announces a new control
